$comment: Whether a member of the public can run `brew install burin` today. This is the one switch the launch flip turns; CI reads it and refuses to disagree with it in either direction. See script/public-install-gate.mjs.
reason: burin-labs/burin-code is a private repository, so every release asset URL 404s anonymously, and no public CLI artifact is published anywhere else. Formula/burin.rb is therefore still head-only and its head clones that private repo.
unblockedBy: Publish the Burin CLI archives somewhere anonymously reachable (public burin-code, a public release mirror, or a public npm scope).
Regenerate the tap from that release: node script/update-from-release.mjs --release-manifest release.json
Flip publicInstallEnabled to true in the same change.
